hooks.command: [ "$CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE" = true ] || exit 0; cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && bash scripts/cloud-agent-db/ensure-pnpm.sh install >/tmp/sokosumi-claude-session-install.log 2>&1 && bash scripts/cloud-agent-db/ensure-pnpm.sh prisma:generate >>/tmp/sokosumi-claude-session-install.log 2>&1 || { echo "cloud session install failed; see /tmp/sokosumi-claude-session-install.log" >&2; exit 1; }
